description: This file defines the 'LoanAccountLock' entity class which manages locking information for loan accounts, including lock owner, timestamp, errors, and related metadata.

classes.name: LoanAccountLock
classes.description: Entity class representing a lock on a loan account, including lock owner, timestamps, and error information.

methods.name: LoanAccountLock
methods.description: Constructor initializing a loan account lock with loan ID, lock owner, and business date; sets lock timestamp using DateUtils.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets the error message and stack trace for the lock, indicating an issue occurred.

methods.name: setNewLockOwner
methods.description: Updates the lock owner and resets the lock placement timestamp.
